acceptance.given: Package A semantic declarations are being authored or updated, and the foundation test will construct disposable package variants using frozen expected field locations derived from the source contract.

oracle.expected: The enumerated semantic-field locations are exclusively skill-quality.v1.json or package-local references; no semantic extension is admitted through Skill frontmatter. The artifact assertions verify the complete declared semantic field set against independently frozen expectations. Each relocation variant triggers its bound AssertionError if misplaced fields are admitted. Any validator result used as derived evidence retains authorizes=[].
forbidden: A semantic field is declared or accepted outside the quality sidecar or package-local references.
A policy or schema change silently permits semantic extensions in Skill frontmatter.
The test derives its expected field locations or allowed frontmatter keys from candidate-controlled policy.
A passing validator status, file existence or plan status substitutes for inspecting the field placement contract.
An absent module, invalid import, missing planned test, environment failure or timeout is classified as causal RED.
The quality declaration repurposes scripts/skill-contract.json or references/skill-input-contract.v1.json.
oracle.observable: An explicit field-to-artifact placement assertion in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a03, evaluated against the normative artifact bytes and disposable package variants, plus structured rejection diagnostics from scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package. Runtime status alone does not establish the structural partition.

acceptance.then: Every semantic field is assigned to skill-quality.v1.json or a package-local reference. The standard, policy and schema preserve that partition, and relocation into unsupported Skill frontmatter is rejected without changing the existing owner-specific contract protocols.
acceptance.when: During foundation contract validation and the final terminal check, inspect the normative standard, policy, quality schema and test package declarations; enumerate each semantic field and resolve its declared storage location. Exercise the real validate_package entry on variants that relocate those fields into Skill frontmatter.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a03 with explicitly bound parameter-level assertions for semantic-field placement. Inspect the actual standard, policy and quality schema, and directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package on disposable package variants. Expect an observable AssertionError when a semantic field is assigned or admitted outside skill-quality.v1.json or package-local references. Run the targeted argv command with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout. This is a structural contract guard, not an expected-red runtime-marker role; inability to import the first production callable is a blocking protocol limitation, not this failure.

Attach this structural guard to the compatible foundation lane and test_a03 selector family; do not create a separate documentation-only executable slice or modify completed workflow controllers.

Changes to shared policy, schema or validator semantics invalidate affected prior proofs and require native re-authoring or replay. Before replay, rebuild the original binding identity and replay using that same identity.
